content:
I am trying to achieve the following setup with hopscotch:

  1. There always is an open bump PR to the last-known-good revision of mathlib (except when mathlib hasn't moved forward since merging the previous such bump PR, which happens for a few hours at a time at most).
  2. Whenever an incompatibility exists, there is an open broken PR bumping to the first-known-bad revision of mathlib.

I am experimenting in toric here: https://github.com/YaelDillies/toric/commit/cdf98dd11d332c0a421761df9945e5592d3b6e2a and I believe I can achieve 2 by adding

        with:
          open-issue: false
          open-pr: true

to the track-incompatibility action call. However, I was expecting 1 to already be achieved and it is not. What am doing wrong?

You can see from the action logs that there are some auth issues creating PRs

pull request create failed: GraphQL: GitHub Actions is not permitted to create or approve pull requests (createPullRequest)

This is a repository setting: check under repository Settings > Actions > General, that you have allowed GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests.

Please could you check under repository Settings > Actions > General, that you have allowed GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests.
I'll add some documentation to the repository regarding auth
